title: Personal Checking: Mobile Deposit, ATM, Debit Card and Zelle Limits
content:
## Limits at a glance

Every Personal Checking tier caps how much can move through self-service channels. Daily figures apply per calendar day; the 30-day figures apply to any rolling window of 30 calendar days. All values are USD.

| Tier | Mobile deposit per day | Mobile deposit per 30 days | ATM cash per day | Debit card purchases per day | Zelle sent per day | Zelle sent per 30 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 1500.00 | 5000.00 | 500.00 | 2500.00 | 500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Student Checking | 1000.00 | 3000.00 | 400.00 | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 3500.00 | 10000.00 | 800.00 | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 10000.00 |
| Interest Checking | 5000.00 | 15000.00 | 1000.00 | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 10000.00 |
| Premier Checking | 10000.00 | 30000.00 | 1500.00 | 7500.00 | 5000.00 | 20000.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 25000.00 | 75000.00 | 2500.00 | 15000.00 | 10000.00 | 40000.00 |

## What each limit measures

- **Mobile deposit** — the total value of checks deposited through the mobile app.
- **ATM cash** — cash withdrawn at ATMs.
- **Debit card purchases** — the value of purchases authorized on the debit card.
- **Zelle sent** — the value of Zelle payments sent.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Student Checking owner who has already sent 1800.00 USD by Zelle in the past 30 days has 200.00 USD of the 2000.00 rolling limit left.
- An Everyday Checking owner who has withdrawn 800.00 USD in cash today has reached that tier's daily ATM figure.
